question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "gaining".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Losing.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Gaining" means acquiring or obtaining something, especially an increase in something valuable. (प्राप्त करना)
◦ Example: She is gaining confidence with every match she plays.

 

• "Losing" means failing to keep or maintain something; being deprived of it, and is therefore the correct antonym. (खोना)
◦ Example: He is losing weight after starting his new diet.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Acquiring (प्राप्त करना): To come into possession of something — a synonym of gaining, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Earning (कमाना): To obtain money or reward through work — a synonym of gaining, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Obtaining (प्राप्त करना): To get or acquire something — a synonym of gaining, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of gaining: acquiring, earning, obtaining, securing, winning.

 

• Synonyms of losing: forfeiting, misplacing, dropping, wasting.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ample (पर्याप्त): Scant (अपर्याप्त), Meager (तुच्छ)

2. Timid (डरपोक): Bold (साहसी), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी)

3. Lucid (स्पष्ट): Confusing (भ्रामक), Obscure (अस्पष्ट)

4. Sturdy (मजबूत): Fragile (नाजुक), Flimsy (कमज़ोर)

5. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (फिजूलखर्ची करने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Accompany."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Abandon.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Accompany" means to go along with someone or something as a companion. (साथ देना)

 

• "Abandon" means to leave someone or something behind completely, and figuratively/practically it suggests deserting a person or duty. It is therefore the correct antonym. (त्याग देना)
◦ Example: The captain refused to abandon the sinking ship.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Escort (साथ ले जाना) — to go with someone to protect or guide them; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 2: Join (शामिल होना) — to come together with someone; a synonym of accompany, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Attend (उपस्थित होना) — to be present with or go along to an event; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of accompany: desert, forsake, leave, ditch.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Evasive (गोलमोल), Deceptive (छलपूर्ण)

2. Meticulous (सूक्ष्म): Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (गंदा)

3. Placid (शांत): Turbulent (उग्र), Agitated (उत्तेजित)

4. Robust (बलवान): Weak (कमजोर), Frail (दुर्बल)

5. Wary (सतर्क): Reckless (लापरवाह), Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "pleasure".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Pain.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Pleasure" means a feeling of happy satisfaction and enjoyment. (आनंद)
◦ Example: Reading books gives her immense pleasure.

 

• "Pain" means physical or emotional suffering or discomfort, and is therefore the correct antonym. (दर्द)
◦ Example: She felt a sharp pain in her knee after the fall.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Joy (हर्ष): A feeling of great happiness — a synonym of pleasure, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Delight (प्रसन्नता): Great pleasure or satisfaction — a synonym of pleasure, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Enjoyment (आनंद): The state of taking pleasure in something — a synonym of pleasure, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of pleasure: joy, delight, enjoyment, satisfaction, happiness.

 

• Synonyms of pain: suffering, agony, distress, discomfort.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Diligent (परिश्रमी): Lazy (आलसी), Idle (निठल्ला)

2. Naive (भोला): Sophisticated (परिष्कृत), Shrewd (चतुर)

3. Opulent (समृद्ध): Poor (गरीब), Modest (सामान्य)

4. Stern (कठोर): Lenient (नरम), Gentle (कोमल)

5. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (निरपेक्ष)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Amusing."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Boring.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Amusing" means causing laughter or providing enjoyment; entertaining in a light-hearted way. (मनोरंजक)

 

• "Boring" means causing weariness or a lack of interest, and figuratively/practically it drains attention rather than holding it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उबाऊ)
◦ Example: The lecture was so boring that half the class fell asleep.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Entertaining (मनोरंजक) — providing enjoyment or amusement; a synonym of amusing.

 

• Option 3: Funny (मज़ेदार) — causing laughter; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 4: Enjoyable (आनंददायक) — giving pleasure or satisfaction; a synonym of amusing, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of amusing: dull, tedious, monotonous, tiresome.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Coarse (खुरदरा): Smooth (चिकना), Refined (परिष्कृत)

2. Docile (आज्ञाकारी): Rebellious (विद्रोही), Stubborn (जिद्दी)

3. Fertile (उपजाऊ): Barren (बंजर), Infertile (बांझ)

4. Gullible (भोला): Skeptical (संशयवादी), Shrewd (चतुर)

5. Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Friendly (मित्रवत), Amicable (सौहार्दपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "forbidden".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Allowed.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Forbidden" means not permitted or allowed, especially by an authority or rule. (निषिद्ध)
◦ Example: Smoking is forbidden inside the hospital premises.

 

• "Allowed" means permitted or given consent to do something, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अनुमति प्राप्त)
◦ Example: Visitors are allowed to enter the museum after 10 a.m.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Prohibited (निषिद्ध): Formally not permitted — a synonym of forbidden, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Banned (प्रतिबंधित): Officially disallowed — a synonym of forbidden, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Restricted (सीमित): Limited or controlled by rules — closely related to forbidden, not its antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of forbidden: prohibited, banned, restricted, disallowed.

 

• Synonyms of allowed: permitted, authorized, sanctioned, approved.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Immense (विशाल): Tiny (छोटा), Minute (सूक्ष्म)

2. Jovial (हंसमुख): Gloomy (उदास), Sullen (चिड़चिड़ा)

3. Keen (उत्सुक): Indifferent (उदासीन), Reluctant (अनिच्छुक)

4. Languid (सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Vigorous (जोरदार)

5. Malicious (द्वेषपूर्ण): Kind (दयालु), Benevolent (परोपकारी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Adventurous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Cautious.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Adventurous" means willing to take risks or try new and exciting experiences. (साहसी)

 

• "Cautious" means careful to avoid danger or mistakes, and figuratively/practically it favors safety over risk. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सतर्क)
◦ Example: The old driver was cautious on the icy road.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Daring (साहसी) — willing to take risks; a synonym of adventurous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Bold (निडर) — showing courage and confidence; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Fearless (निर्भीक) — without fear; a synonym of adventurous, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of adventurous: timid, careful, unadventurous, prudent.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Nimble (फुर्तीला): Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Sluggish (सुस्त)

2. Obstinate (जिद्दी): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (आज्ञाकारी)

3. Pristine (अछूता): Polluted (प्रदूषित), Contaminated (दूषित)

4. Reticent (मितभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Outspoken (स्पष्टवादी)

5. Sparse (विरल): Dense (घना), Plentiful (प्रचुर मात्रा में)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "fresh".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Stale.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Fresh" means newly made, obtained, or grown; not stale or spoiled. (ताज़ा)
◦ Example: We bought fresh vegetables from the morning market.

 

• "Stale" means no longer fresh; having lost its original quality, especially food that has gone hard or spoiled, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बासी)
◦ Example: The bread had gone stale after being left out overnight.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: New (नया): Recently made or introduced — a synonym of fresh, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Recent (हाल का): Having happened lately — a synonym of fresh in the sense of newness, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Novel (नवीन): New and original — a synonym of fresh, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of fresh: new, recent, novel, crisp, unspoiled.

 

• Synonyms of stale: musty, spoiled, old, flat.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Tranquil (शांत): Turbulent (अशांत), Chaotic (अराजक)

2. Vague (अस्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Precise (सटीक)

3. Wicked (दुष्ट): Virtuous (सदाचारी), Righteous (धर्मी)

4. Abrupt (अचानक): Gradual (क्रमिक), Smooth (सहज)

5. Blunt (कुंद): Sharp (तेज़), Subtle (सूक्ष्म)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Fancy."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Simple.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Fancy" means elaborate or highly decorated in style; not plain. (सजावटी)

 

• "Simple" means plain, basic, and without unnecessary decoration, and figuratively/practically it favors ease over complexity. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सादा)
◦ Example: She wore a simple white dress to the ceremony.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Elaborate (विस्तृत) — having many carefully arranged parts or details; a synonym of fancy, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Ornate (अलंकृत) — made in an elaborate, decorative style; a synonym of fancy, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Decorative (सजावटी) — serving to make something look more attractive; a synonym of fancy, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of fancy: plain, basic, modest, unadorned.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ancient (प्राचीन): Modern (आधुनिक), Contemporary (समकालीन)

2. Brisk (तेज़): Slow (धीमा), Sluggish (सुस्त)

3. Callous (निर्दयी): Compassionate (दयालु), Sensitive (संवेदनशील)

4. Deft (निपुण): Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Awkward (भद्दा)

5. Feeble (कमजोर): Strong (मजबूत), Powerful (शक्तिशाली)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "flee".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Stay.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Flee" means to run away quickly from danger or threat. (भाग जाना)
◦ Example: The villagers had to flee their homes during the flood.

 

• "Stay" means to remain in a place rather than leaving it, and is therefore the correct antonym. (रुकना)
◦ Example: Despite the storm warning, they decided to stay at home.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Escape (भाग निकलना): To get free from danger or confinement — a synonym of flee, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Run away (भाग जाना): To leave a place suddenly to avoid something — a synonym of flee, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Bolt (अचानक भाग जाना): To run away suddenly — a synonym of flee, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of flee: escape, run away, bolt, abscond.

 

• Synonyms of stay: remain, wait, linger, stop.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Harsh (कठोर): Gentle (कोमल), Mild (हल्का)

2. Idle (आलसी): Busy (व्यस्त), Active (सक्रिय)

3. Jubilant (हर्षित): Sad (दुखी), Sorrowful (शोकाकुल)

4. Lofty (उदात्त): Lowly (निम्न), Modest (विनम्र)

5. Meek (नम्र): Aggressive (आक्रामक), Assertive (दृढ़)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Admire."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Despise.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Admire" means to regard someone or something with respect and warm approval. (प्रशंसा करना)

 

• "Despise" means to feel deep contempt or dislike for someone or something, and figuratively/practically it reflects strong disapproval. It is therefore the correct antonym. (घृणा करना)
◦ Example: He despised dishonesty in every form.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Respect (सम्मान करना) — to hold in high regard; a synonym of admire, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Esteem (आदर करना) — to think highly of someone; a synonym of admire, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Appreciate (सराहना करना) — to recognize the value of something; a synonym of admire, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of admire: disdain, scorn, dislike, contempt (for).

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Optimistic (आशावादी): Pessimistic (निराशावादी), Cynical (संशयवादी)

2. Punctual (समयनिष्ठ): Late (देर से आने वाला), Tardy (देर करने वाला)

3. Rigorous (सख्त): Lenient (नरम), Lax (ढीला)

4. Serene (शांत): Agitated (उत्तेजित), Troubled (व्याकुल)

5. Thrifty (मितव्ययी): Lavish (खर्चीला), Prodigal (उड़ाऊ)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "grabbed".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Release.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Grabbed" means took hold of something suddenly and firmly. (पकड़ लिया)
◦ Example: She grabbed her umbrella before rushing out into the rain.

 

• "Release" means to set something or someone free, or to let go of one's hold, and is therefore the correct antonym. (छोड़ना)
◦ Example: The officer decided to release the prisoner on parole.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Seized (जब्त कर लिया): Took hold of forcefully or suddenly — a synonym of grabbed, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Snatched (छीन लिया): Grabbed something quickly and often forcibly — a synonym of grabbed, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Clutched (कसकर पकड़ लिया): Held something tightly — a synonym of grabbed, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of grabbed: seized, snatched, clutched, gripped.

 

• Synonyms of release: free, liberate, let go, discharge.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vigilant (सतर्क): Negligent (लापरवाह), Inattentive (असावधान)

2. Wholesome (स्वास्थ्यप्रद): Unhealthy (अस्वस्थकर), Harmful (हानिकारक)

3. Volatile (अस्थिर): Stable (स्थिर), Steady (दृढ़)

4. Austere (सादा): Luxurious (विलासी), Lavish (भव्य)

5. Pungent (तीखा): Mild (हल्का), Bland (फीका)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Disgusting."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Delightful.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Disgusting" means extremely unpleasant or causing a strong feeling of dislike. (घिनौना/घृणित)

 

• "Delightful" means highly pleasing or charming, and figuratively something that brings genuine joy and satisfaction. It is therefore the correct antonym. (आनंददायक)
◦ Example: The garden was filled with a delightful fragrance of fresh flowers.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Repulsive (घृणित) — causing strong dislike or disgust; a synonym of disgusting, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Nauseating (जी मिचलाने वाला) — causing a feeling of sickness or revulsion; a synonym in meaning.

 

• Option 4: Revolting (घृणास्पद) — extremely unpleasant or offensive; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of disgusting: pleasant, appealing, attractive, agreeable, wonderful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Diligent (मेहनती): Lazy (आलसी), Idle (निष्क्रिय)

2. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

3. Genuine (वास्तविक): Fake (नकली), Counterfeit (जाली)

4. Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Friendly (मित्रवत), Amicable (सौहार्दपूर्ण)

5. Meticulous (सूक्ष्म/सावधान): Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (ढीला-ढाला)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "improvement".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Deterioration.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Improvement" means the act or process of making something better or more favorable. (सुधार)
◦ Example: The new training program led to a significant improvement in employee performance.

 

• "Deterioration" means the process of becoming progressively worse, and is therefore the correct antonym. (गिरावट)
◦ Example: Years of neglect caused a steady deterioration in the building's condition.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Enhancement (वृद्धि): An increase in quality or value — a synonym of improvement, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Advancement (उन्नति): Forward movement or progress in development — a synonym of improvement, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Progress (प्रगति): Forward or onward movement toward a better state — a synonym of improvement, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of improvement: enhancement, advancement, progress, betterment, refinement.

 

• Synonyms of deterioration: decline, degeneration, worsening, decay, regression.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Abundant (प्रचुर): Scarce (दुर्लभ), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त)

2. Ancient (प्राचीन): Modern (आधुनिक), Recent (हालिया)

3. Benevolent (परोपकारी): Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण), Cruel (क्रूर)

4. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला), Deceptive (धोखेबाज़)

5. Deceitful (छलपूर्ण): Honest (ईमानदार), Truthful (सच्चा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Disagree."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Concur.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Disagree" means to hold a different opinion or to not accept something as correct. (असहमत होना)

 

• "Concur" means to agree with or hold the same opinion as someone, and figuratively to be in accord on a matter. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सहमत होना)
◦ Example: All the committee members concurred with the chairman's final decision.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Dispute (विवाद करना) — to argue against or question the truth of something; a synonym of disagree, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Dissent (असहमति जताना) — to hold or express opinions that differ from those officially held; a synonym of disagree.

 

• Option 3: Object (आपत्ति करना) — to express opposition to something; a synonym of disagree, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of disagree: agree, accept, consent, approve, accord.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Eloquent (वाक्पटु): Inarticulate (अस्पष्टवादी), Incoherent (असंगत)

2. Frivolous (तुच्छ): Serious (गंभीर), Sensible (समझदार)

3. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Reserved (संकोची), Solitary (एकांतप्रिय)

4. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (घमंडी), Proud (अभिमानी)

5. Impartial (निष्पक्ष): Biased (पक्षपाती), Partial (पक्षपातपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "interruption".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Continuation.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Interruption" means a break or pause caused by someone or something stopping a process temporarily. (व्यवधान)
◦ Example: The power outage caused a brief interruption in the video conference.

 

• "Continuation" means the act of carrying something on without a break, and is therefore the correct antonym. (निरंतरता)
◦ Example: The workshop is a continuation of the training that began last month.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Disruption (व्यवधान): A disturbance that interrupts an event or process — a synonym of interruption, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Disturbance (गड़बड़ी): Something that interrupts a state of peace or continuity — a synonym of interruption.

 

• Option 4: Suspension (स्थगन): A temporary halting of an activity — a synonym of interruption, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of interruption: disruption, disturbance, suspension, break, pause.

 

• Synonyms of continuation: continuance, persistence, extension, prolongation.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Jovial (हंसमुख): Gloomy (उदास), Melancholy (खिन्न)

2. Lethargic (सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Active (सक्रिय)

3. Magnanimous (उदार): Petty (क्षुद्र), Selfish (स्वार्थी)

4. Naive (भोला): Sophisticated (परिष्कृत), Worldly (व्यवहारकुशल)

5. Obstinate (जिद्दी): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (आज्ञाकारी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Convenient."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Inopportune.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Convenient" means suitable for one's needs or fitting in well with a person's plans, without causing trouble. (सुविधाजनक)

 

• "Inopportune" means occurring at a time that is not suitable or well-chosen, and figuratively causing awkwardness or difficulty. It is therefore the correct antonym. (असामयिक)
◦ Example: The salesman called at a most inopportune moment, right in the middle of dinner.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Suitable (उपयुक्त) — appropriate or fitting for a purpose; a synonym of convenient, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Handy (सुगम) — easy to use or within reach; a synonym of convenient in the sense of usefulness.

 

• Option 4: Accessible (सुलभ) — able to be easily reached or obtained; a synonym of convenient, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of convenient: inconvenient, awkward, troublesome, unsuitable, bothersome.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक): Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Impractical (अव्यावहारिक)

2. Quaint (विचित्र पुरातन): Ordinary (साधारण), Contemporary (समकालीन)

3. Reticent (मितभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Outspoken (मुखर)

4. Sporadic (छिटपुट): Frequent (बार-बार), Regular (नियमित)

5. Tedious (उबाऊ): Interesting (रोचक), Exciting (रोमांचक)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "guiltiness".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Innocence.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Guiltiness" means the state or fact of having committed a wrong or offense; a feeling of responsibility for wrongdoing. (दोषीपन)
◦ Example: A deep sense of guiltiness kept him awake all night after the accident.

 

• "Innocence" means the state of being free from guilt or wrongdoing, and is therefore the correct antonym. (निर्दोषता)
◦ Example: The jury was finally convinced of the defendant's innocence.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Culpability (दोषीपन): Responsibility for a fault or wrong — a synonym of guiltiness, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Blameworthiness (दोषपूर्णता): The quality of deserving blame — a synonym of guiltiness.

 

• Option 4: Guilt (अपराधबोध): The fact or state of having committed an offense — a synonym of guiltiness, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of guiltiness: culpability, blameworthiness, guilt, responsibility, wrongdoing.

 

• Synonyms of innocence: guiltlessness, blamelessness, purity, virtue.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ubiquitous (सर्वव्यापी): Rare (दुर्लभ), Uncommon (असामान्य)

2. Vivacious (जीवंत): Dull (नीरस), Listless (सुस्त)

3. Wary (सतर्क): Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला), Unsuspecting (शक रहित)

4. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (उदासीन), Half-hearted (अधूरे मन से)

5. Amiable (मिलनसार): Unfriendly (अमित्र), Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Charming."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Repulsive.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Charming" means pleasant or attractive in a way that charms and delights people. (आकर्षक)

 

• "Repulsive" means causing intense distaste or aversion, and figuratively so unpleasant that it pushes people away. It is therefore the correct antonym. (घृणित)
◦ Example: The rotten smell coming from the drain was absolutely repulsive.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Attractive (आकर्षक) — pleasing to look at or be near; a synonym of charming, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Enchanting (मंत्रमुग्ध करने वाला) — delightfully charming or captivating; a synonym of charming.

 

• Option 3: Alluring (मोहक) — attractive in a way that arouses interest; a synonym of charming, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of charming: repulsive, unpleasant, unattractive, off-putting, disagreeable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Brittle (भंगुर): Flexible (लचीला), Tough (मजबूत)

2. Coherent (सुसंगत): Incoherent (असंगत), Confusing (भ्रामक)

3. Elated (अत्यंत प्रसन्न): Depressed (उदास), Dejected (निराश)

4. Feeble (कमजोर): Strong (मजबूत), Robust (सुदृढ़)

5. Gullible (भोला): Skeptical (संशयवादी), Shrewd (चालाक)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "horrible".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Pleasant.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Horrible" means causing horror or extreme unpleasantness; very disagreeable or dreadful. (भयानक)
◦ Example: The soldiers witnessed some horrible scenes during the war.

 

• "Pleasant" means giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सुखद)
◦ Example: We spent a pleasant afternoon walking by the lake.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Dreadful (भयावह): Causing great fear or suffering — a synonym of horrible, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Terrible (भयंकर): Extremely bad or unpleasant — a synonym of horrible.

 

• Option 4: Ghastly (डरावना): Causing great horror or fear — a synonym of horrible, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of horrible: dreadful, terrible, ghastly, awful, appalling.

 

• Synonyms of pleasant: agreeable, enjoyable, delightful, pleasing.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Hasty (जल्दबाज़): Deliberate (सोच-समझकर किया गया), Cautious (सतर्क)

2. Immense (विशाल): Tiny (छोटा), Minuscule (अत्यंत छोटा)

3. Judicious (विवेकपूर्ण): Injudicious (अविवेकपूर्ण), Foolish (मूर्खतापूर्ण)

4. Keen (उत्सुक): Reluctant (अनिच्छुक), Indifferent (उदासीन)

5. Lavish (भव्य): Modest (सादा), Sparse (विरल)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Displayed."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Hidden.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Displayed" means shown or put on view for people to see. (प्रदर्शित)

 

• "Hidden" means kept out of sight or concealed from view, and figuratively kept secret from others. It is therefore the correct antonym. (छिपा हुआ)
◦ Example: The old letters were hidden in a locked drawer for decades.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Exhibited (प्रदर्शित किया गया) — put on public display; a synonym of displayed, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Showcased (प्रस्तुत किया गया) — presented in an attractive way for public viewing; a synonym of displayed.

 

• Option 4: Exposed (उजागर किया गया) — made visible or uncovered; a synonym of displayed, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of displayed: hidden, concealed, covered, withheld, suppressed.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Meek (नम्र): Assertive (दृढ़), Aggressive (आक्रामक)

2. Notorious (कुख्यात): Reputable (प्रतिष्ठित), Honorable (सम्मानित)

3. Opulent (समृद्ध): Poor (गरीब), Impoverished (दरिद्र)

4. Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण): Reckless (लापरवाह), Imprudent (अविवेकपूर्ण)

5. Rigid (कठोर): Flexible (लचीला), Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "convince".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Dissuade.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Convince" means to cause someone to firmly believe in the truth of something or persuade them to do something. (मनाना)
◦ Example: She tried to convince her parents to let her study abroad.

 

• "Dissuade" means to persuade someone not to take a particular course of action, and is therefore the correct antonym. (हतोत्साहित करना)
◦ Example: His friends tried to dissuade him from quitting his stable job.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Persuade (राजी करना): To cause someone to do or believe something through reasoning — a synonym of convince, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Assure (आश्वस्त करना): To tell someone confidently that something is true, removing doubt — a synonym of convince.

 

• Option 4: Induce (प्रेरित करना): To succeed in persuading someone to do something — a synonym of convince, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of convince: persuade, assure, satisfy, induce, win over.

 

• Synonyms of dissuade: discourage, deter, divert, talk out of.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Somber (गंभीर): Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Bright (उज्ज्वल)

2. Tranquil (शांत): Turbulent (अशांत), Chaotic (अराजक)

3. Urbane (शिष्ट): Uncouth (असभ्य), Boorish (गंवारू)

4. Vague (अस्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Precise (सटीक)

5. Wicked (दुष्ट): Virtuous (सदाचारी), Righteous (धर्मी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Scared."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Brave.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Scared" means feeling fear or being frightened by something. (डरा हुआ)

 

• "Brave" means ready to face and endure danger or pain without showing fear, and figuratively showing courage in difficult situations. It is therefore the correct antonym. (बहादुर)
◦ Example: The brave firefighter rushed into the burning building to save the children.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Frightened (भयभीत) — afraid or anxious; a synonym of scared, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Terrified (आतंकित) — extremely frightened; a synonym of scared.

 

• Option 3: Afraid (डरा हुआ) — feeling fear or anxiety; a synonym of scared, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of scared: brave, fearless, courageous, bold, confident.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Yielding (नम्र): Firm (दृढ़), Resistant (प्रतिरोधी)

2. Austere (कठोर): Luxurious (विलासितापूर्ण), Ornate (अलंकृत)

3. Bleak (निराशाजनक): Promising (आशाजनक), Cheerful (प्रसन्न)

4. Cordial (सौहार्दपूर्ण): Unfriendly (अमित्र), Cold (रूखा)

5. Dormant (निष्क्रिय): Active (सक्रिय), Awake (जागृत)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "fact".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Fiction.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Fact" means a thing that is known or proved to be true, based on actual evidence. (तथ्य)
◦ Example: It is a well-known fact that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.

 

• "Fiction" means something invented or imagined that is not based on fact, and is therefore the correct antonym. (कल्पना)
◦ Example: The novel blends historical fact with pure fiction.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Truth (सत्य): That which is in accordance with fact or reality — a synonym of fact, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Reality (वास्तविकता): The state of things as they actually exist — a synonym of fact.

 

• Option 4: Actuality (यथार्थता): The quality of being real or actual — a synonym of fact, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of fact: truth, reality, actuality, certainty, verity.

 

• Synonyms of fiction: fantasy, invention, fabrication, imagination.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Exuberant (जोशीला): Reserved (संकोची), Subdued (दबा हुआ)

2. Fickle (चंचल): Constant (स्थिर), Steadfast (दृढ़)

3. Gaunt (कृशकाय): Plump (गोल-मटोल), Stout (हृष्ट-पुष्ट)

4. Haughty (घमंडी): Humble (विनम्र), Modest (साधारण)

5. Insolent (ढीठ): Polite (विनम्र), Respectful (सम्मानजनक)
